posts.title: Building a Calm Personal Blog with Solid 2
posts.description: A small, durable foundation for a personal blog.
posts.markdown:
# Building a Calm Personal Blog with Solid 2

A personal site should stay small enough to understand in one sitting.

## Why this stack

Solid keeps the UI direct while a scheduled Notion snapshot keeps credentials and content work off the browser.

<callout icon="🌿" color="green_bg">
The deployed site reads static content. A failed sync leaves the previous snapshot untouched.
</callout>

```ts
const source = 'notion'
const renderer = 'solid'
```

- Content sync runs on the server.
- Tailwind owns design tokens.
- Preline consumes the same theme.
